# requires: store
#
# Every operation the contract names, against every state a record can be in.
#
# The other scenarios each test a rule somebody thought of. This one is the
# table itself, so a cell nobody thought of still gets driven — and the cells
# the pages do not settle are marked `# undecided` and asserted about by nothing,
# instead of being pinned to whatever the three implementations happened to do.
# That is where `renew` was hiding: allowed on a terminal record in all five
# stores, written down in none of them, and found by a person reading them side
# by side rather than by any instrument here.
#
# One job per cell that would move the state, and one job for the cells that
# cannot: a terminal record refuses everything but `renew`, so all six of its
# operations run against the same record and leave it where they found it.
#
# Leases are 60s and there is no `sleep`, so nothing in this file depends on a
# clock. Sweep-by-state lives in orphans.txt and is not repeated here; the one
# `orphans` at the end is a cross-check that the states above are what they say.
submit P size=64 digest=good src=file
renew P ghost 60000
progress P ghost 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
release P ghost
finish P ghost complete
intent P pause
submit Pc size=64 digest=good src=file
claim Pc pc 60000
submit R size=64 digest=good src=file
claim R rw 60000
claim R rival 60000
renew R rw 60000
progress R rw 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
intent R pause
submit Rl size=64 digest=good src=file
claim Rl rl 60000
release Rl rl
submit Rf size=64 digest=good src=file
claim Rf rf 60000
finish Rf rf complete
submit T size=64 digest=good src=file
claim T tw 60000
finish T tw transferred
renew T tw 60000
progress T tw 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
intent T pause
release T tw
submit Tc size=64 digest=good src=file
claim Tc tc 60000
finish Tc tc transferred
release Tc tc
claim Tc tc2 60000
submit Tf size=64 digest=good src=file
claim Tf tf 60000
finish Tf tf transferred
finish Tf tf complete
submit C size=64 digest=good src=file
claim C cw 60000
finish C cw complete
claim C cw2 60000
renew C cw 60000
progress C cw 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
release C cw
finish C cw failed
intent C pause
submit F size=64 digest=good src=file
claim F fw 60000
finish F fw failed
claim F fw2 60000
renew F fw 60000
progress F fw 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
release F fw
finish F fw complete
intent F pause
submit X size=64 digest=good src=file
claim X xw 60000
finish X xw cancelled
claim X xw2 60000
renew X xw 60000
progress X xw 8 {"verified_prefix":8}
release X xw
finish X xw complete
intent X pause
orphans

# undecided 2: renew against a record nobody has ever held — no page says
# undecided 12: renew while the lease is live — no page says when renew succeeds, only that a terminal record still accepts it
# undecided 25: update on transferred — the page says terminal refuses updates and that transferred is not terminal, and never closes the gap
# undecided 26: intent on transferred — same gap, same sentence
# undecided 27: release on transferred — the page states only that releasing turns running back into pending
